subtasks.goal: Handle the full flight change for reservation R2087 (passenger Dana Whitfield, SFO to ORD on 2026-08-03) end to end. If the flight she is currently on is already the earliest one with availability, that means no change is needed, but confirm this by checking all flights that day. 5) Change reservation R2087's relevant segment to that earliest qualifying flight, keeping the same cabin. 6) Determine what she owes: charge the change fee only if her tier is not exempt (per the fare rules read in step 3); separately, if the new flight's fare in that cabin is higher than what she originally paid, charge the fare difference in full (never refund if the new fare is cheaper, and no tier is exempt from a fare difference). Charge each applicable amount using the charge_fee tool with the correct category (change_fee and/or fare_difference), citing the reasoning in the note. 7) Only touch reservation R2087 - do not modify any other reservation.
